note: Here the text uses a truncated Taylor expansion of √(1+x) to turn closeness of the two vectors into a lower bound for the convolution. In the proof of conv2_ge, [L] reaches that lower-bound form with the exact polarization identity instead.

have heq : conv2 ρ = (∫ t, etaO t ^ 2) - (1 / 2) * ∫ t, (etaO (t + s) - etaO t) ^ 2 := by
    unfold conv2
    simp_rw [hpt]
    have h1 : Integrable fun t => etaO t ^ 2 + etaO (t + s) ^ 2 := integrable_etaO_sq.add hshift
    rw [integral_div, integral_sub h1 hdiff, integral_add integrable_etaO_sq hshift,
      integral_add_right_eq_self (fun t => etaO t ^ 2) s]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have := integral_sq_etaO_shift_le s
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Exact polarization with the shifted copy of η◦ (|w| = |v|) gives conv2 ρ = ‖η◦‖₂² − ½‖η◦(·+s) − η◦‖₂².
